The site is Market Cross Farmers Market — Stallholder Pitch & Power Booking, a booking web application for Weekend farmers market pitch booking and power requirements.

Owner brief: "Our town council organizes a bi-weekly farmers market and needs a vendor pitch reservation system. Stallholders should be able to view available outdoor and covered market pitches, specify refrigeration and electrical supply needs, and book a pitch for upcoming market days. Bookings must be stored on the server so the market master can review the stall layout after refreshing the master plan."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-24/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Market Cross Farmers Market — Stallholder Pitch & Power Booking: the page for weekend farmers market pitch booking and power requirements, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #991b1b (fm-red), #fefce8 (fm-straw), #166534 (fm-green), #ffffff (fm-card), #fecaca (fm-border), #1c1917 (fm-text), #78716c (fm-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid #e7e5e4, page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a calendar widget that hides the available slots behind extra clicks; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Market Cross Farmers Market — Stallholder Pitch & Power Booking as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Vendor trading name", "Contact email", "Contact phone", "Market pitch selection", "Produce category", "Electrical supply requirement", "Equipment and setup notes").

User journey context: Inspect the market pitch layout map and find available stalls for an upcoming Saturday. Fill out vendor reservation details including produce category and electrical hookup requests. Submit the pitch booking, receive a vendor confirmation permit, and reload to confirm persistence.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
